name: Phase Equilibria and Transformations
description: Equilibrium, Gibbs free energy concept for single and binary systems, chemical potential; regular solution model; evolution of phase diagrams; order of phase transformation; ternary equilibrium, ternary isotherms, activity diagrams, introduction and classification of phase transformation. Diffusion in solids: Fick’s 1st and 2nd laws, the Kirkendall effect, Arken’s analysis, various diffusion mechanisms. Thermodynamics of transformation: free energy of solid solutions, order of transformation, driving force for first order transformation with and without composition change, second order transformation, spinodal decomposition. Nucleation kinetics: homogeneous and heterogeneous nucleation, homogeneous nucleation with composition change, heterogeneous nucleation, strain energy effects. Interfacial free energy, grain boundary characteristics, grain growth kinetics; interphase interfaces in solids; interface migration; overall transformation kinetics, Johnson-Mehl-Avarami model. Particle coarsening. Recovery, recrystallization and grain growth. Diffusionless transformation, precipitation process; TTT diagram; cellular precipitation; Eutectoid transformation; Bainite transformation; massive transformation; order-to-disorder transformation.
